description: RegEvidenceHub Waste helps users navigate England waste regulatory workflows using bounded, evidence-linked preflight tools. It can route current waste operations, check carrier/broker/dealer registration lifecycle questions, assess Digital Waste Tracking receiving-site readiness, screen proposed permit-impact changes, and report official-source health. It uses user-supplied facts, fails closed when decisive evidence is stale or incomplete, does not submit anything to the Environment Agency, and does not provide regulator approval or legal advice.

defaultPrompt: We receive non-hazardous controlled waste at our permitted site in England. What waste-rule route should we check first?
